basis: Extensin-like protein; promoter-GUS in trichoblasts but not atrichoblasts, tied to hair tip growth (Bucher et al. 2002 Plant Physiol); trichoblast-specific in Canto-Pastor 2024 scRNA (ED Fig. 4e) and an EP CTEG in Kajala 2021 TRAP. Raised one level for cross-study agreement.

Extensin-like; root-hair-preferential mRNA by organ blots only (Bucher et al. 1997 Plant Mol Biol); strong, specific trichoblast marker in Canto-Pastor 2024; highest in the AtWER (epidermis) TRAP line among cell-type lines but not a Kajala CTEG. Raised low to medium for agreement.

Extensin-like; root-hair-preferential mRNA (Bucher et al. 1997 Plant Mol Biol); specific but low in the Canto-Pastor 2024 trichoblast cluster; highest in the AtWER TRAP line among cell-type lines. Raised low to medium for agreement.

Ammonium transporter; Canto-Pastor 2024 atrichoblast > trichoblast, Kajala EP CTEG (whole epidermis). Conflict: Lauter et al. 1996 PNAS report LeAmt1 transcripts preferentially in root hairs. Treat as epidermis-level.

MFS phosphate transporter; Canto-Pastor 2024 atrichoblast > trichoblast (also clearly in trichoblasts); Kajala EP CTEG. Marked tomato-validated in Canto-Pastor ED Fig. 4e (reference not checked). Epidermis-level.

Suberin feruloyl transferase; promoter:NLS-2xGFP exodermis-specific and CRISPR mutants lose exodermal suberin (Canto-Pastor et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Marks the mature, suberizing exodermis only. Conflict: listed as a QC CTEG in Kajala 2021 Table S1, though its TRAP signal is highest in the SlPEP (exodermis+cortex) line.

MYB suberin regulator; promoter:nlsGFP exodermis-specific and EXO CTEG (Kajala 2021); hairy-root mutants show exodermal suberin phenotypes (Canto-Pastor 2024 ED Fig. 6). Same ID is slmyb107a (Manzano 2025) and MYB102 (UniProt). Not detected in the scRNA exodermal trajectory; low expression.

Suberin glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase; CRISPR hairy-root mutants lose suberin, exodermis cluster in scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024); EXO CTEG in Kajala 2021. Raised for agreement. Some meristem signal in scRNA.
Suberin GPAT; CRISPR hairy-root suberin loss and exodermis-restricted in scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024). Highest in the SlPEP TRAP line but not a Kajala CTEG.
MYB suberin regulator; CRISPR mutants lose exodermal suberin and transcript restricted to the mature exodermis tip in scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024). No reporter; ~0 CPM in the 1 cm Kajala TRAP root tips.
Long-chain acyl-CoA synthetase; CRISPR suberin loss and exodermis in scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024). In ITAG4.1 but not in UniProt or the ITAG3.2 TRAP count table.
WRKY TF; promoter:nlsGFP exodermis-specific and EXO CTEG (Kajala 2021 Fig. 1F). Low expression (~2 CPM); not in the Canto-Pastor panel.

C2H2 TF that represses polar lignin cap formation in the inner cortex (mutants, Manzano et al. 2025 Nat Plants); EXO+gCOR CTEG with equal TRAP signal in SlPEP and AtPEP lines, so not exodermis-specific.
3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase of suberin synthesis; exodermis in scRNA only (Canto-Pastor 2024 Fig. 2e), weak in trichoblasts.
Fatty acyl-CoA reductase of suberin synthesis; exodermis in scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024 Fig. 2e); mutant staining phenotype reported there (not re-checked).
Fatty acyl-CoA reductase; exodermis in scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024 Fig. 2e). The paper's text gives Solyc11g067190, which is not in ITAG4.1; the Fig. 2e ID is used.
GPI-anchored LTP; top gene of the mature-exodermis trajectory (Canto-Pastor 2024 Table S3). Conflict: an EP (epidermis) CTEG in Kajala 2021.

Fe2OG dioxygenase; promoter drives cortex expression in mature roots (Jones et al. 2008 Funct Plant Biol); cortex in Canto-Pastor 2024 scRNA (low in exodermis). Conflict: EXO CTEG in Kajala 2021 (SlPEP 434 vs AtPEP 214 CPM), so not raised.

Aspartyl protease whose promoter marks exodermis plus two inner cortex layers (Kajala 2021 Table S1); cortex > exodermis in Canto-Pastor 2024. Ground-tissue marker: does not separate cortex from exodermis.

GRAS TF; cortex in Canto-Pastor 2024 (marked tomato-validated, reference not identified) and gCOR+iCOR CTEG in Kajala 2021 with AtPEP (cortex) > SlPEP (exodermis) TRAP signal. Raised low to medium for agreement; separates cortex from exodermis.

Uncharacterized; strong, specific cortex marker in Canto-Pastor 2024 and highest in the two cortex TRAP lines (AtPEP 80, SlPEP 70 vs <=22 CPM; not a CTEG). Not in UniProt. Also cortex-specific in Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious roots (0.42 vs <=0.13); not raised further because it is expression-only and the Yang cortex label is merged (Revise).
JACKDAW ortholog (ground-tissue C2H2 TF in Arabidopsis); gCOR+iCOR CTEG (Kajala 2021). Not in the Canto-Pastor panel.
Cortex cluster 2.47 vs <=0.52 (Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious-root scRNA pseudobulk); unvalidated, and the Yang cortex cluster is merged (Revise).
SCARECROW ortholog; promoter marks endodermis plus one QC tier (Kajala 2021 Table S1; Ron et al. 2014); 75.8 TPM in the SlSCR line vs <=10 elsewhere and an EN core CTEG in plate and field.

Casparian strip protein; transcriptional reporter mainly endodermis and translational fusion at the CS (Manzano et al. 2025 Nat Plants); endodermis-specific in Canto-Pastor 2024. Called SlCASP1b in Li 2018. Conflict: an MZ (not EN) CTEG in Kajala 2021.

Casparian strip protein; reporter mainly endodermis and translational fusion at the CS (Manzano 2025); endodermis-specific in Canto-Pastor 2024. Called SlCASP1a in Li 2018. Conflict: an MZ CTEG in Kajala 2021.

CASP family; strongest endodermis marker in Canto-Pastor 2024 scRNA, but the transcriptional reporter is in endodermis, cortex and exodermis and the protein does not localize to the CS (Manzano 2025). Called SlCASP1c in Li 2018; MZ CTEG in Kajala 2021.

MYB36 homolog; promoter-GUS mostly endodermis (Li et al. 2018 Front Plant Sci, named SlMYB36a) and endodermis-specific in Canto-Pastor 2024 (SlMYB36-like). Raised for agreement. Not the functional MYB36: its mutant keeps the CS (Manzano 2025).

Closest AtMYB36 ortholog; CRISPR mutants lack the Casparian strip (Manzano 2025). Reported endodermis-enriched in TRAP there, but median CPM in the GEO count table is not higher in the SlSCR line; not in the Canto-Pastor panel. Check in data.
PER64 ortholog (CS lignin peroxidase in Arabidopsis); promoter-GUS endodermis-specific from the onset of differentiation (Li 2018) and an EN CTEG in Kajala 2021. Raised for agreement. Low expression.

SCHENGEN3 ortholog; mutants have an interrupted CS (Manzano 2025). Conflict on domain: endodermis-specific GUS (Li 2018, SlSGN3a) vs GFP in endodermis, inner cortex and exodermis (Manzano 2025) and an EXO+gCOR CTEG (Kajala 2021). Weak as a marker.
Uncharacterized C2H2 zinc finger; EN core CTEG in both plate and field TRAP (Kajala 2021 Table S2); 7.9 CPM in the SlSCR line vs <=1.9 in others.

SHORT-ROOT ortholog; promoter marks stele in the meristem (Kajala 2021 Table S1; Ron 2014) and vascular tissue (Li 2018 GUS). Transcript only weakly enriched (15 CPM in SlSHR line vs <=12) and not a CTEG, so a weak expression marker.

Dof zinc-finger TF (MINI-EX regulon hub in Yang 2025); merged "Root stele" 0.68 and phloem 0.27 vs <=0.03 elsewhere (Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious-root scRNA pseudobulk). Pan-stele hint; no reporter.
Xylem sap protein 10 kDa (Rep et al. 2003); merged "Root stele" cluster 0.76 vs <=0.05 (Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious-root scRNA pseudobulk). Cannot place within stele (xylem vs parenchyma).
Uncharacterized; strong, specific pericycle marker in Canto-Pastor 2024 scRNA. Not in UniProt or the ITAG3.2 count table. XPP vs PPP not resolved.
Shaker K+ outward channel (xylem loading by pericycle/stele in Arabidopsis); pericycle in Canto-Pastor 2024 only; not enriched in the Kajala SlSHR line.
S-type anion channel (xylem-pole pericycle in Arabidopsis); pericycle in Canto-Pastor 2024 only.

ALTERED PHLOEM DEVELOPMENT ortholog (phloem identity in Arabidopsis); 79 TPM in the AtS32 phloem TRAP line vs <=4 elsewhere (Kajala 2021) and phloem/procambium-specific in Canto-Pastor 2024 (few cells). Raised for agreement. SE and CC not resolved. Third independent study agrees: Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious-root phloem cluster 0.30 vs <=0.01 elsewhere (already high).
Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase (CVP2, provascular/phloem in Arabidopsis); PH CTEG (Kajala 2021) and phloem/procambium in Canto-Pastor 2024 (few cells). Raised low to medium.

PHLOEM PROTEIN 2-LIKE A9-like; PH CTEG (Kajala 2021) and phloem/procambium in Canto-Pastor 2024 (few cells). Raised low to medium (Kajala + CP), then medium to high on 2026-10-20 because a third, independent study (Yang 2025 bioRxiv, adventitious root) has it phloem-specific (0.68 vs <=0.06).
PIN5 ortholog; highest in the phloem TRAP line (8.6 TPM) and a PH CTEG (Kajala 2021 Table S1).

Chloroplast-movement protein (function unrelated to phloem); RNA in situ in the peripheral stele of adventitious roots (Yang 2025 bioRxiv Fig 1h, image not viewed) and phloem cluster 1.51 vs <=0.09 elsewhere. Single study. ITAG4.0 version .3 in Yang.
Metallothionein type 2A; phloem cluster 3.50 vs <=0.31 (Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious-root scRNA pseudobulk). Metallothioneins are stress-responsive; unvalidated.
Uncharacterized DUF7866 protein; phloem cluster 2.06 vs <=0.03 (Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious-root scRNA pseudobulk); specific to one lineage, single study.
Uncharacterized gene, no UniProt entry (present in ITAG4.1 features); phloem cluster 2.27 vs <=0.04 (Yang 2025 bioRxiv adventitious-root scRNA pseudobulk); single study.

Dof TF (AtDOF5.6/HCA2; listed under Phloem in arabidopsis_root.tsv); phloem/procambium in Canto-Pastor 2024 (weak) and a V (whole stele) CTEG in Kajala 2021. Not raised: agreement only at stele level.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (CESA8-like); strong, specific xylem marker in Canto-Pastor 2024 and a V (stele) CTEG in Kajala 2021 (not in the XY list). Differentiating xylem; proto vs metaxylem not split.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (CESA4-like); strong, specific xylem marker in Canto-Pastor 2024 and a V CTEG in Kajala 2021 (not in the XY list).
Papain-like cysteine protease (xylem PCD); strong, specific xylem marker in Canto-Pastor 2024 and a V CTEG in Kajala 2021 (350 CPM in SlSHR line vs <=44 in other cell-type lines).
UDP-glucuronate decarboxylase (xylan synthesis); strong xylem marker in Canto-Pastor 2024; highest in the SlSHR TRAP line but not a CTEG.
NAC master regulator of vessel secondary walls; overexpression gives ectopic secondary walls in all root cells (Kajala 2021 Fig. 2A, Table S3) and a V CTEG. Named SlVND7 in the preprint.
KNOX TF; XY CTEG and overexpression adds protoxylem files (Kajala 2021 Fig. 2D, Table S3). Not in the Canto-Pastor panel. Low expression.
bZIP TF; XY CTEG and overexpression adds protoxylem files (Kajala 2021 Fig. 2C). ITAG3.2 ID absent from the ITAG4.1 features of Canto-Pastor 2024: map before use.

WOX5 ortholog; promoter domain is QC plus vascular initials (Kajala 2021 Table S1), 1516 TPM in the SlWOX5 line vs <=1.3 elsewhere. Barely detected in Canto-Pastor 2024 scRNA (grouped under pericycle).
AP2/ERF annotated PLETHORA3; RC/Col/QC cluster > meristem in Canto-Pastor 2024. Conflict: Kajala 2021 Table S1 uses Solyc11g010710 for PLT3. Name by orthology not checked.
SHOOT GRAVITROPISM9 ortholog (amyloplast E3 ligase); RC/Col/QC cluster in Canto-Pastor 2024. Conflict: gCOR+iCOR CTEG (<=2.7 CPM) in Kajala 2021. Not in UniProt.
FEZ ortholog (root-cap stem-cell NAC in Arabidopsis); weak in the Canto-Pastor 2024 RC/Col/QC cluster; MZ CTEG in Kajala 2021.
Auxin response factor (ARF10B in UniProt); RC/Col/QC cluster in Canto-Pastor 2024, marked tomato-validated (Bouzroud 2018, not checked). Root cap vs columella not resolved.

AB hydrolase-1 protein; RNA in situ at the adventitious-root tip (Yang 2025 bioRxiv Fig 1i, image not viewed), but only weakly enriched in the putative root-cap cluster (1.32 vs 0.48-0.87). Authors call the label putative (classifier F1 0.32). Hypothesis only.
G2/M cyclin; meristematic-zone cluster in Canto-Pastor 2024 and highest in the MZ (SlRPL11C) TRAP line (Kajala 2021 GEO counts). Raised for agreement. Not in UniProt.
A-type cyclin (G2/M); meristematic-zone cluster in Canto-Pastor 2024 and highest in the MZ TRAP line.

A3-type cyclin; meristematic-zone cluster in Canto-Pastor 2024 only; not MZ-peaked in TRAP. Also specific to the Yang 2025 bioRxiv "QC" cluster (0.13 vs <=0.01), which is a proliferation state; not raised (two cluster calls, no validation).

Replication-dependent histone; top gene of the Yang 2025 "QC" cluster (1.13 vs <=0.18), which has the highest cell-cycle score. Multicopy family (UniProt P35057 maps to 7 genes); reads may be split among paralogs.
Replication-dependent histone; Yang 2025 "QC" (proliferation) cluster 1.23 vs <=0.06. Multicopy family (UniProt K4AY75 maps to 5 genes).
Histone H2A.1; Yang 2025 "QC" (proliferation) cluster 1.84 vs <=0.68 (weak margin).

Heat-stress TF; ortholog of AtHSFA2 in the Denyer 2019 protoplast-induced set mapped to tomato; 0.27 in the Yang 2025 "LRC" stress cluster vs <=0.03. Not in the Canto-Pastor 2024 tomato protoplasting list (Table S2), so the heat-shock response may be protocol-specific.
Heat-shock ClpB chaperone; protoplast-induced ortholog (Denyer 2019 via Yang 2025); top gene of the Yang "LRC" stress cluster (2.90 vs <=1.16). Not in the Canto-Pastor 2024 tomato protoplasting list.
HSP90 chaperone; protoplast-induced ortholog; Yang 2025 "LRC" stress cluster 2.69 vs <=1.00. Not in the Canto-Pastor 2024 tomato protoplasting list.

Heat shock protein 90; the Yang 2025 authors use it as their "LRC marker", but it is a heat-shock chaperone in a stress-state cluster (3.33 vs <=1.85). Not in the Canto-Pastor 2024 tomato protoplasting list.
Small HSP (UniProt: SHSP domain protein); protoplast-induced ortholog; Yang 2025 "LRC" stress cluster 1.53 vs <=0.43. Not in the Canto-Pastor 2024 tomato protoplasting list.
HSP70-like (UniProt: uncharacterized); protoplast-induced ortholog; Yang 2025 "LRC" stress cluster 1.58 vs <=0.51. Not in the Canto-Pastor 2024 tomato protoplasting list.

AP2/ERF wound/protoplast-induced TF; in the Canto-Pastor 2024 tomato root protoplasting list (Table S2, logFC 9.8) and highest in the Yang 2025 Unknown_1 (2.13) and "LRC" (1.93) clusters. Raised low to medium for agreement of two independent studies.
